hobbies.name: Trekking
hobbies.line: Mountain trails are where I reset — long climbs, no notifications, a clear head on the way down.

hobbies.name: Riding
hobbies.line: Long rides on open roads. Few things clear the mind like a good stretch of highway.

hobbies.name: Running
hobbies.line: Running is my thinking time — a lot of stubborn problems quietly untangle themselves mid-run.

hobbies.name: Badminton
hobbies.line: My favourite sport. Fast, tactical, and the best kind of competitive — always up for a game.

facts: Off the keyboard, I'm usually on a trail — trekking in the mountains is how I reset.
Long rides clear my head better than any debugger.
Running is where I do my best thinking; plenty of design decisions get settled somewhere along the route.
Badminton is my sport of choice — fast, tactical, and genuinely competitive. Always happy to play.
Mountains, open roads, running and badminton have one thing in common with engineering: they reward showing up consistently.
